articles.title: McBride sets single-season TE receptions mark
articles.summary: The Cardinals' Trey McBride set the NFL record for most receptions by a tight end (117) Sunday, passing the mark set by Zach Ertz in 2018.

articles.title: Illness has Bears WR Moore questionable to play
articles.summary: The Bears added wide receivers DJ Moore and Olamide Zaccheaus to the injury report Sunday morning with an illness and designated both as questionable to play against the 49ers.

articles.title: Henry up to 10th all time in rushing, Ravens win
articles.summary: Baltimore running back Derrick Henry moved into 10th place all time in NFL rushing yards Saturday night, finishing with 216, to go along with four touchdowns on the ground, as the Ravens produced a 41-24 win over the Green Bay Packers at Lambeau Field.

articles.title: Packers unsure on Week 18 QB after Willis shines
articles.summary: Packers coach Matt LaFleur was noncommittal about the team's starting quarterback for next weekend's regular-season finale after backup quarterback Malik Willis went 18-of-21 for 288 yards and a touchdown in Saturday's loss to the Ravens.

articles.title: Sources: DE Crosby expected to need surgery
articles.summary: Raiders star Maxx Crosby is expected to need left knee surgery that would sideline the Pro Bowl pass rusher for at least the better part of the offseason, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Broncos clinch West, ending Chiefs' 9-year reign
articles.summary: The Broncos ended the Chiefs' nine-year run atop the AFC West, clinching the division title Saturday after the Chargers lost to the Texans.
